svg.title: Tracking Monkey Typing: commits
svg.desc: Tracking Monkey Typing shows lifetime aggregate weekly commits. Totals: 27,675 GitHub-credited commits and 23,235 authored commits. The 4,440-commit gap contains merges and deploys and is drawn as the band between the total boundary and authored line. 207 active weeks. COMMITS / WEEK · SQRT. The complete lifetime record covers 476 weekly buckets through the last completed day.
